role: Senior Data Analytics Engineer - Data Insights

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: We're growing quickly and have a lot to accomplish
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (data quality, trusted/well-defined data, best practices) are balanced against multiple velocity phrases ("growing quickly", "a lot to accomplish"), giving parity rather than dominance of either.
evidence.domain_risk: achieving a trusted, accessible and well-defined view of information across the company
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is a SaaS company (Jira/Atlassian ecosystem tooling) building internal analytics/BI infrastructure with no financial reporting, regulatory, or safety-critical language present.
evidence.collaboration_width: Analytics Engineers; Data Engineers; Data Analysts; Business Partners
evidence.data_team_maturity: build, define and activate Appfire's company-wide data asset (Snowflake) from ground up data sources
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role explicitly builds the company's data foundation from ground-up sources, defining metrics and the semantic layer for the first time, a clear greenfield/early-stage signal despite some named tooling.
evidence.jd_authorship: Architect, build, and launch efficient & reliable data models and pipelines in partnership with Data Engineering, leveraging DBT and Snowflake
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise tools and concrete deliverables (DBT, Snowflake metrics layers, semantic layer, KPI definitions) giving a clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Understand decision needs by interfacing with fellow Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, Data Analysts and Business Partners
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's primary audience is the data function and enabling company-wide self-service analytics, rather than any single external commercial, product, or finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: build, define and activate Appfire's company-wide data asset (Snowflake) from ground up data sources... Define and share best practices
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role builds foundational company-wide data infrastructure from scratch and defines best practices/standards, placing it clearly in strategic, direction-setting territory.
evidence.ai_role: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools and techniques to enhance dbt development, increase efficiency, and strengthen documentation.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is explicitly expected to use AI tools to accelerate their own dbt development and documentation work, a clear ai_user signal.
evidence.testing_framing: You will work with stakeholders across Appfire to integrate, test, connect, and build brand new data and metrics
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is named as an owned activity the candidate performs in building the data foundation, alongside a stated passion for data quality, though not framed as a formal contracts/observability program.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in capability and delivery terms (building foundations, enabling decisions, scaling impact) with no risk register, incident, or compliance language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: build, define and activate Appfire's company-wide data asset (Snowflake) from ground up data sources
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The explicit "from ground up data sources" framing plus "brand new data and metrics" indicates the role is building foundational infrastructure rather than fixing or scaling an existing one.
evidence.work_arrangement: Flexibility - This role is fully remote within Bulgaria
